sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina MFA: live visa nationality selector and individually selected residual country cards
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA's live mvp.gov.ba visa page identifies the Ministry and supplies a public country selector. On 2026-08-22 every listed residual nationality card was replayed from that selector; each assigned card expressly says its nationals require or need a visa for entry, exit or transit, often naming the issuing diplomatic mission.
sources.supportingExcerpt: This page contains basic visa information for foreign citizens traveling to Bosnia and Herzegovina.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina MFA: China, Hong Kong SAR, Macao SAR and Taiwan visa information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current MFA country card is published on mvp.gov.ba and expressly distinguishes PRC ordinary passports, Taiwan passports with a specified identity-card number, and Hong Kong/Macao SAR passports for inbound Bosnia and Herzegovina entry.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Holders of passports issued in the Special Administrative Region: Hong Kong and Macau are exempted from visa regime.

sources.title: Rulebook on the procedure of visa issuance in diplomatic and consular missions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA hosts the operative Rulebook for short-stay visa issuance. It directs a foreign national to submit a visa application to the competent Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic-consular mission according to residence.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A foreign national shall submit visa application to the authorized DKP BiH, according to the place of applicant's residence.

sources.title: FIPA: Visas and information for visitors
sources.publisher: Foreign Investment Promotion Agency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The Council of Ministers' FIPA visitor page describes the separate exception for nationals subject to a visa regime who also hold a valid multiple-entry Schengen, EU or United States visa or qualifying residence permit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: provided they hold a valid multiple-entry visa or a residence permit issued by Schengen, EU or United States authorities.

policies.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina: directly replayed residual ordinary-passport advance-visa cohort
policies.summary: The MFA's current, individually selected nationality cards expressly require an entry/transit visa for this ordinary-passport residual cohort. The cards route issuance through a Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic or consular mission; this is an advance visa, not a nationality-wide eVisa or visa on arrival.
conditions: This is the ordinary visitor-passport baseline from the directly replayed MFA inbound country cards. It excludes diplomatic, official, service, business, residence, employment, transit-only and final-admission cases.

A separate conditional waiver for a traveller holding a qualifying multiple-entry Schengen, EU or United States visa or qualifying residence permit is not generalized to the nationality-only baseline.
The Rulebook's individual urgent border-visa procedure is not a nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route.

policies.title: Hong Kong SAR passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The MFA's current China card expressly exempts Hong Kong SAR passports from Bosnia and Herzegovina's visa regime for entry, exit and transit, up to 90 days in six months from first entry.
conditions: This applies to the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport described by the MFA, not a PRC ordinary passport, a Macao SAR passport, a Taiwan passport or a business, diplomatic or residence document.
The stated short-stay limit is up to 90 days during six months from first entry. Work, residence, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.

unresolved.reason: Kosovo is absent from the MFA's current nationality selector. The current official material reviewed does not expressly classify a Kosovo ordinary passport, and no entry conclusion is inferred from silence, recognition status, historic material or conditional third-country-document substitutions.

South Sudan has no current individual country card in the MFA selector's published country list. The reviewed official sources do not supply an exhaustive operative advance-visa complement, so no ordinary-passport result is inferred from its absence.
